summary: Closed Set 09 F35 for the DXVK one-click path by adding executable behavior tests for preflight identity/slot precedence/provider metadata and launcher target-lock, and by extending the existing selector transaction test with a successful dxvk-safe post-selection root-attestation path. Structural text checks remain, but the critical DXVK one-click identity/mutation boundaries are now behavior-tested.

review.adversarial: Fixtures deliberately re-seal package hashes before slot/provider/package mismatch cases so the intended identity gate, not the preceding package-integrity gate, is what rejects each case. Target-lock uses throwing stubs to prove rejection happens before selector/preflight/runner execution.
